Product Engineer  

 Role Overview  

 Game Plan Tech is seeking a Product Engineer who blends strategic product leadership with hands-on execution in an AI-native environment. This role shapes product vision, improves delivery processes across teams, and establishes the next generation of product practices in an organization that is moving quickly toward high-velocity, AI-enabled development.You will work closely with engineering, technical project managers, and customer-facing leads to bring clarity to priorities, eliminate friction, strengthen communication loops, and help define the operating model for how modern product work is done. This is not a traditional product owner or legacy product manager role. It is a forward-leaning position that leverages generative AI to accelerate strategy, planning, communication, and delivery.

 Desired Qualifications 

 
 Strong engineering foundation and fluency in how modern software systems are designed, built, and operated

 Proven success leading complex technical projects or product work in fast-moving environments

 Ability to partner deeply with engineers and earn trust through clarity, judgment, and technical reasoning

 Experience managing roadmaps, translating stakeholder needs, and structuring product decisions

 Knowledge of implementing solutions leveraging AI tooling (Gemini, Claude, OpenAI, etc.)

 Commitment to high-quality communication, organization, and writing

 
 Key Responsibilities 

 
 Orchestrate human-in-the-loop AI by designing and executing “research, plan, implement” workflows where you guide AI agents to produce high-quality artifacts, ensuring we build with AI, not just use it.

 Translate code to value by acting as the connective tissue between engineering and customers, turning technical constraints into business strategy and stakeholder needs into clear technical requirements.

 Lead rapid prototyping by using generative tools to build instant prototypes and dashboards that prove value before we write a single line of production code, skipping long dev cycles for validation.

 Experiment, test, and deploy new capabilities aligned with project demand and needs, assessing outcomes and integrating successful approaches into team processes.

 Conduct market research including competitor analysis, staying current with LLM advancements and agentic workflows, and adapting tooling and processes accordingly.

 
 Who You Are 

 
 You are a system thinker who understands cloud environments and system architecture, caring more about how the pieces fit together.

 You are an AI practitioner who understands LLMs and agentic workflows and has shipped products leveraging AI.

 You are a curious experimenter with an aptitude to constantly learn and grow in your craft.

 
 Why Game Plan Tech? 

 Join a dynamic and growing team at Game Plan Tech, dedicated to empowering public sector organizations with best-in-class Google solutions. We foster a collaborative environment where you can make a significant impact, drive innovation for our clients, and advance your career.

 Game Plan Tech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We value diversity and are committed to ensuring a respectful, inclusive, and supportive environment for all employees, contractors, and applicants.

 If you require reasonable accommodation during the application process or employment, please contact hr@gameplan.tech.
